scope: Runtime allocation recovery; complete-block acceptance remains a separate gate

observed_failure.qualification: Live lease accounting excludes unleased PCS/domain allocations. The diagnostic establishes physical exhaustion, rather than the explicit admitted-capacity errors.

recovery.registry: Publish the allocation only after success; failure output is null

checks: injected pool-allocation OOM with real CUDA per-thread OOM state recovers
live allocation queued on another lane retains exact contents
two failures produce one retry only
failed allocation leaves custody registry unchanged and output null
non-OOM error does not trim or retry
